Specsmaxxing: I Wrote YAML Specs for My AI Agents — Here's What Changed (and What Didn't)
A YAML spec for an AI agent is basically the blueprint you leave for the contractor when you can't be on-site. If the blueprint is solid, they build exactly what you want. If there's one ambiguous detail — "wall at the back" with no measurements — they make a call, and when you show up, the wall is in the wrong place. Once you see it that way, you can't unsee it in every prompt you throw at an agent. entry.title: I Solved 200 LeetCode Problems and Still Froze in Interviews
entry.summary: A few years ago I solved 200 LeetCode problems and still froze on Mediums I hadn't seen. The breakthrough wasn't another hundred problems. It was a different loop. A problem asks for the longest substring with at most K distinct characters. You've solved sliding window before. Maximum sum subarray of size K, done.
